decision_basis: Exact GALP-GALR1 agonist/binding evidence with receptor-proximal Gi/o signaling supports qualified-high relay/function; central GALP phenotypes were not abolished by GALR1 knockout, so GALR1 is not treated as the sole in-vivo mediator.

Exact GALP-GALR2 binding/agonism and [35S]GTPgammaS receptor-proximal activation support qualified-high subtype-specific relay/function; central GALP phenotypes were not abolished by GALR2 knockout, so GALR2 is not treated as the sole in-vivo mediator.

Exact GAS6-TYRO3 activation with receptor phosphorylation and Shc/B-Raf plus PLCgamma-PKCalpha neuronal signaling supports qualified-high relay/function; gamma-carboxylated GAS6, phosphatidylserine/cofactor dependence, and engineered-versus-neuronal context remain explicit.
